title: The Painted Witness
author: Lior Ashgrove
blurb: Oscar Marchetti, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
